title: Month 2, Week 3 (Dec 20 – Dec 26, 2026): Bone Tumors II, Fibro-Osseous Lesions, Milan Salivary FNA & Salivary Surgical Path

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall Epiphyseal Bone Tumor differential (Giant cell tumor of bone, Chondroblastoma, Clear cell chondrosarcoma) vs. Diaphyseal differential (Ewing, Osteoid osteoma, Fibrous dysplasia, Adamantinoma).
Reading (75m): WHO 5th Ed. — Giant Cell Tumor of Bone (Epiphyseal; H3.3 G34W IHC+ in mononuclear stromal cells, H3F3A mut; denosumab treatment effect mimicking osteosarcoma!), Chondroblastoma (chicken-wire calcification, H3.3 K36M IHC+, DOG1+, S100+), Chondromyxoid Fibroma (GRM1), Aneurysmal Bone Cyst (USP6), Non-Ossifying Fibroma, Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis (BRAF V600E, CD1a+, Langerin+), & Adamantinoma.
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 Bone slides @ 3m/case (GCT of bone vs. Denosumab-treated GCTB, Chondroblastoma, Chondromyxoid fibroma, ABC, LCH grooved coffee-bean nuclei).
QBank (30m): 15 Bone Tumor MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the critical SOE trap: Denosumab-Treated Giant Cell Tumor of Bone (depletion of osteoclast-like giant cells + woven bone deposition mimicking osteosarcoma—ask for medication history and stain with H3.3 G34W!).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Compare H3.3 G34W (GCTB) vs. H3.3 K36M (Chondroblastoma) vs. FOS/FOSB (Osteoid osteoma/Osteoblastoma) vs. Brachyury (Chordoma) vs. MDM2 (Parosteal OS).
Reading (75m): Curriculum Appendix E & WHO 5th Ed. — Maxillofacial Fibro-Osseous & Odontogenic Lesions: Fibrous Dysplasia (GNAS mut, woven bone trabeculae WITHOUT osteoblastic rimming), Ossifying Fibroma (well-circumscribed on imaging, trabeculae WITH osteoblastic rimming + juvenile variants), Cemento-Osseous Dysplasia, Ameloblastoma (BRAF V600E, Vickers-Gorlin criteria), Odontogenic Keratocyst (PTCH1, corrugated parakeratin), & Pindborg Tumor (amyloid).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Fibrous dysplasia, Ossifying fibroma, Ameloblastoma, Odontogenic keratocyst, Dentigerous cyst).
QBank (20m): 15 Fibro-Osseous & Odontogenic MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study the Fibro-Osseous Comparison Table in One-Pager 3 (Fibrous Dysplasia vs. Ossifying Fibroma vs. Cemento-Osseous Dysplasia).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the 6 diagnostic categories of the Milan System for Reporting Salivary Gland Cytopathology with ROM and management (I: Non-Diagnostic, II: Non-Neoplastic, III: AUS, IVA: Benign Neoplasm, IVB: SUMP, V: Suspicious, VI: Malignant).
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Slides: 5 Bone/Odontogenic Spot Slides (3m/case) + 5 Salivary FNA slides (Pleomorphic adenoma fibrillary matrix, Warthin tumor oncocytes + lymphocytes, Adenoid cystic hyaline globules, MEC, Acinic cell @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Salivary FNA & Bone MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the Salivary FNA trap: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (Milan VI; MYB::NFIB) vs. Pleomorphic Adenoma / Basal Cell Adenoma (Milan IVA/IVB).

days.b1: Secondary System — Salivary Gland Surgical Pathology (90m): WHO Head & Neck 5th Ed. — Pleomorphic Adenoma (PLAG1/HMGA2) & Ca ex-PA; Warthin Tumor; Basal Cell Adenoma (nuclear β-catenin+, CTNNB1) vs. Canalicular Adenoma (upper lip, S100+); Mucoepidermoid Carcinoma (CRTC1/3::MAML2, p63/p40+, mucicarmine+); Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma (MYB::NFIB, biphasic CD117+ & p63/SMA/S100+, solid >30% = high grade); Acinic Cell Carcinoma (PAS-D+ zymogen granules, NR4A3 [NOR1]+, DOG1+); Secretory Carcinoma (ETV6::NTRK3, S100+, Mammaglobin+, Pan-TRK+); Polymorphous Adenocarcinoma (targetoid perineural, p63+ / p40- discordance!, PRKD1); & Salivary Duct Carcinoma (AR+, HER2+).
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Salivary Gland MCQs + 5 Salivary Spot Slides (MEC, AdCC, Acinic cell vs. Secretory carcinoma, PAC, Salivary duct carcinoma).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 4 (Salivary Gland IHC, Translocation & Milan FNA Master Table).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Recall the Salivary Gland IHC & Gene Fusion table (PA, MEC, AdCC, Acinic cell, Secretory, PAC, Hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma EWSR1::ATF1, Salivary duct carcinoma).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Bone/Salivary + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Bone, Fibro-Osseous & Salivary Glands).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect every recall distractor.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Add missed Bone & Salivary recall pitfalls to your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 3 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 3 of Month 2 to GitHub.

days.b1: Soft Tissue & Bone Full Consolidation + Intraoperative Consultation Traps (2.5h): Complete review of One-Pagers 1–3 + Susan Lester Soft Tissue & Bone Intraoperative Consultation (avoiding definitive sarcoma subtyping on frozen section; triaging fresh tissue for FISH/molecular; ensuring EDTA decalcification).
days.b2: Soft Tissue & Bone Mastery Mini-Mock (90m): 20 Timed Soft Tissue & Bone Virtual Spot Slides (60m @ 3m/case) + 30 Timed Soft Tissue/Bone MCQs (30m).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Update your Soft Tissue & Bone Confidence Slider in Tab 4 (Target: 1/5 -> 3/5) and run a 20m SOE station on a Retroperitoneal Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma (MDM2/CDK4).
